summary: Full testing of Community Reviews feature (backend + frontend). All 14 backend tests passed and all frontend interaction tests passed. The Reviews page is fully functional end-to-end.

issues: Console shows hydration warning: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' and '<span> cannot be a child of <select>'. Caused by Emergent dev tools injecting spans into the DOM. Not a production issue — select/option HTML rendering is working correctly in UI.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Community Reviews feature at /reviews is fully working.
